title: Profile suggestions
description: Profile suggestions shipped with the hub. starter = created at the first start of the hub; all are in the gallery and can be added any number of times. Adding copies the suggestion into an independent profile (values = catalog defaults overlaid with rules; fixed and user_choice as listed); an update of this file never changes existing profiles or devices. A higher version makes the hub offer “new version of the suggestion” for profiles whose origin has an older version (only with preview and confirmation).

catalog_version.description: Catalog version the suggestions were written for.

kind.description: Kind of the profile created from this suggestion.

description.description: Summary sentence of the profile card.

intended_for.description: Gallery grouping only; any profile can be assigned to members and guests (guests: not with parental controls).

default_for.description: Starter suggestions: default profile of these device types after the first start.

area_patterns.description: When the admin adds the suggestion, the hub preselects the active areas whose name has a word starting with one of these lower-case prefixes (case-insensitive, any language) into areas.area_ids of the new profile (only for areas mode selected). The admin sees and changes the choice; the profile keeps concrete areas (copied).

rules.description: Values that differ from the catalog defaults.

fixed.description: Complete list of rules with checkbox “Fixed”.

user_choice.description: Complete list of rules with “User's choice”.
